Step 4 formalizes these as 'Root Cause 1: Convention Reference Formatter Produces Kebab-Case Instead of Title Case' and 'Root Cause 2: Task Creation Uses Feature Issue Type Instead of Task Issue Type', with an Independence Assessment confirming they are in different modules and code paths.
